evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A categorical distinction presented as a logical premise — argument from definitional contrast rather than authority or appeal.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Logical valuation argument (commodity vs. asset) carries a rational-persuasion base; the aspirational register of 'the asset you keep' adds an inspirational-appeal tactic.

mints.name: AssetFramingAsPersuasion
mints.title: the perspective is the asset you keep
mints.frame: Is the speaker claiming authority by reframing what the audience already values as an asset to retain, rather than by rank or evidence?
